# Rehabilitation Recover Health

Online medical clinic offering doctor, physiotherapy and dietitian 
consultations via WhatsApp and Google Meet, every day after 5 PM IST.

## Services
- Doctor consultation (₹300): Dr Savan Kukadia, MBBS MD — chronic 
  disease, diabetes, hypertension, thyroid, general medicine
- Physiotherapy (₹300): Dr Roshani Tank, MPT — live online 
  physiotherapy, rehabilitation, pain management, back and joint pain
- Dietitian (₹300, or ₹1,000 for 4 sessions): Dr Roshani Tank — 
  nutrition planning, weight management, diabetes diet, lifestyle
